author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
We should BAN people naming their AI agents with human sound like names.

All AI agents should be named following the human master's userid-agent123 convention, so there is no illusion the AI is doing any work on its own.  It is just the human engineer using AI as a tool.   AI is no different than your good old bash script.

https://lnkd.in/gZA6tD6D
